_what_this_is: the candidate fillers for S_STANDARD_REF, as RECORDS — the column that is empty in 20 of 21 domains and is the PRECONDITION for G_CONFORMANCE
_why_it_matters: without a standard reference there is no delta, and the delta IS the product. G is empty everywhere BECAUSE S is. This is the highest-value unblock available.

_the_distinction_that_matters.SAP_STANDARD: how SAP ships and intends the module to work. Only the peer-installation material qualifies.
_the_distinction_that_matters.AS_DESIGNED: how UNESCO INTENDED to run it, authored by SAP SE / SAP Suisse / Capgemini in 2016-2019. Not the SAP baseline, but a legitimate reference to conform AS-RUN against.
_the_distinction_that_matters.why_the_difference_bites: calling as-designed 'standard' would make every UNESCO-specific choice look like SAP behaviour, and every deviation from SAP look like a defect. Two different yardsticks, two different findings.

_provenance_warning: unesco-sap-brain declares us its UPSTREAM (refs_external.json: abapobjectscreation = 'SAP execution truth source'). Every DATA-derived claim there comes from OUR golden. What is genuinely theirs and unreproducible is this 2016-2019 design corpus — hand-written extracts of the original PDFs, which are also held there.
